summary: First-run e2e testing of the E-RYDEZ Operations Console. Backend: 37/37 pytest tests pass across overview, work items (all 10 views + patch), orders (5 filters + search + detail + notes + pause/resume), conversations (filters, detail, send, patch), fulfillment (list + scan mismatch + scan match + advance to Fulfilled requiring tracking with 422), inventory (ATP math, waiting_orders sorted oldest-first), returns (list + detail + state change appends timeline), appointments (patch to Checked in), automations (patch status, runs list/detail), approvals (reject without reason -> 422, approve success, already-decided -> 400), search (weber/RMA/VX2), reports, integrations, notifications. Frontend: Overview loads with 4 clickable KPI cards that navigate; Work queue loads 15 rows, drawer opens on row click, drawer-assign-me works, keyboard J navigation works, multi-select checkboxes present (15); Order detail E-1001 shows all expected panels, Pause updates dialog requires reason (confirm disabled without reason), pause succeeds with suppression-note visible; Save note works and shows 'Saved' state; Inbox loads 10 conversations, thread opens, AI draft inserts labelled Suggested draft with facts; Fulfillment list has 7 scan buttons; Board view toggle works; Inventory, Returns, RMA-2031, Appointments, Automations Rules, Reports, Purchasing, Settings sections (users/integrations/rules/templates) all render; Global search '/' opens dialog and returns 2 order results for 'weber'; Integration health + notifications popovers open; Sidebar toggle works.

ui_bugs.issue: Bare /settings path does not render (only /settings/:section is defined). Sidebar links go to /settings but there is no default redirect.

issues: Console a11y warning: `DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle` for screen readers. Add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle to dialogs (e.g., Global search dialog, some Automations dialogs).

action_items: Add a default redirect from /settings to /settings/users (or make section param optional) so the sidebar 'Settings' link renders content.
Wrap DialogTitle inside global-search-dialog and any other Dialogs missing a title with @radix-ui/react-visually-hidden VisuallyHidden to satisfy a11y (fixes console warning).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py fulfillment advance uses STAGES[min(idx+1,6)] which correctly caps advancement at Fulfilled, but there is no explicit business rule enforcing tracking on Packed->Carrier handoff (only on final step to Fulfilled). This matches spec but consider clarifying in code comment.
server.py list_work_items filter `overdue-orders` uses substring 'unfulfilled' in reason text (fragile — depends on seed wording). Prefer a category or flag field.
server.py orders 'q' search does not filter by 'over-14' filter together cleanly; filter is applied after q which is fine but sorting only by business_day_age desc (no secondary key). Minor.
OrderDetail pause-updates dialog: confirm-pause-btn is correctly disabled without reason. Good UX.
No default redirect for /settings — router omission. Add <Route path="/settings" element={<Navigate to="/settings/users" replace />} /> in App.js.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all pages load, core flows work; minor route + a11y issues)

seed_data_creation: Used POST /api/reset at test start to seed the database; test mutations touched E-1001 (notes/pause), RMA-2031 (state change), a Packed shipping fulfillment (advanced to Fulfilled with test tracking), and 2 pending approvals (1 rejected, 1 approved). Recommend main agent call POST /api/reset before self-verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives in /app/backend/tests/test_erydez_backend.py and runs against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. It reseeds once via autouse session fixture. Test data references: order E-1001 (paid, awaiting stock, 17 business days), RMA-2031 (returns state change), inventory SKU VX2-PRO-GT (waiting orders + inbound POs). Approvals APR-112..APR-118 seeded with at least 2 Pending. Fulfillment advance-to-Fulfilled requires either tracking or exception_reason on the LAST hop (Carrier handoff -> Fulfilled), not Packed -> Carrier handoff.
